description: This file defines functionality for limiting the size of JPEG images by adjusting image quality and dimensions to meet a maximum byte size constraint. It contains a data class for the result and an object with a method implementing the compression logic with scaling and quality adjustments.

classes.name: JpegSizeLimiterResult
classes.description: Data class representing the result of JPEG size limiting, including the compressed bytes, image dimensions, and quality used.

methods.name: compressToLimit
methods.description: Compresses an image to meet a maximum byte size by adjusting quality and dimensions with scaling attempts. Returns the best compressed result.
